【主题参考拼版提示词.txt】
Compose the four provided REAL theme artworks into a flat 2-by-2 reference contact sheet, PNG on warm white. Each quadrant should contain its corresponding complete original image fitted without distortion. Preserve actual artwork and all characters exactly; no redrawing or substitute generic art. Upper left: input1, five YOYO figurines, all five fully visible. Upper right: input2, Shinchan plush collage. Lower left: input3, SpongeBob and Patrick in teal water. Lower right: input4, colorful beach vacation group. Thin 12px white gutters, no text, no labels, no decoration, no borders, no perspective. This is an intermediate asset board for accurate placement into an infographic. Output landscape 1536x1024.


【AIYOUcodex-一周更新-知识卡片提示词.txt】
Create ONE polished tall Chinese knowledge infographic, portrait 1440×2560, PNG. This is the AIYOUcodex weekly product update card for 2026-10-08 through 2026-10-14 (China time). All visible Chinese text must be precise, large, readable and typeset professionally. Warm off-white background #FBFAF4, dark navy typography, blue and teal accents, subtle dividers, clean editorial layout. Use an integrated editorial flow, not many nested boxes. Do not add invented statistics, features or QR codes.

CRITICAL: The supplied four image inputs are supporting insert/compositing inputs from the ACTUAL theme assets. Use them recognizably in the theme gallery with their identities and details preserved. Do NOT replace them with generic seaside art or made-up substitute illustrations. Image 1 is the actual photographic seaside glasses woman from 海岛心动陪伴. Keep her face, glasses, pose and photographic quality faithful. Input 2 is a contact sheet: its upper-left quadrant is five colorful YOYO figurines, upper-right is the plush Shinchan collage, lower-left is SpongeBob and Patrick on floating beach chairs in teal water, lower-right is the colorful beach vacation group. Separate these four artworks from the contact sheet and place into their individual theme tiles. Input 3 is dark metallic mecha in a hangar; input 4 is a pink fluffy rabbit among clouds. In the instructions below, Image 2 means input2 upper-left, Image3 means input2 upper-right, Image4 means input2 lower-left, Image5 means input2 lower-right, Image6 means input3, Image7 means input4. Maintain the appearance of each reference; crop for layout only. Do not invent application interface screenshots.
